newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Advest on AFLAC, UNUM, Provident.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Advest on AFLAC, UNUM, Provident.

text.p: -- Advest analyst Gloria Vogel said she started coverage of AFLAC Inc and UNUM Corp with accumulate ratings and Provident Cos Inc with a buy rating.
-- Vogel said she has 12-month price target of $40 a share for AFLAC, $75 a share for UNUM and $50 a share for Provident.

-- Vogel said she was recommending those stocks based on a favorable outlook for the disability insurance market, which she said has the potential for growth. Efficient product distribution and marketing as well as more rational pricing contribute to the more favorable outlook, she said.
